This update fixes two problems that showed up when the app was opened after sitting idle for a while.

## Fixes

- Screens now load after the server has been asleep. The API runs on Render's free tier, which can take a minute or more to boot. The app used to give up after 45 seconds and show an error. It now pings the server as soon as it opens or comes back to the foreground, and keeps retrying requests until the server answers.
- Sign out works straight away. It used to wait for the server to confirm before clearing your session, so it looked like nothing happened while the server was asleep. The session is now cleared on the phone first and revoked on the server in the background.
- A token refresh that fails only because the server is unreachable no longer signs you out. You stay signed in and the request is retried.

## Download

Install `TaskForge-1.0.1-arm64-v8a.apk` on most phones, or `TaskForge-1.0.1-universal.apk` if you are not sure. It installs over 1.0.0 and keeps you signed in.

Demo account: `admin@taskforge.dev` with the password `TaskForge2024!`.
